note: Local programmes and contacts for the CA-10 corridor. Every entry names its agency and links to that agency's own page rather than restating terms we would then have to keep in sync. All are in the verify-before-launch register: programme funding and deadlines change annually, and sending someone to a closed programme wastes a trip.

resources.name: Free chipping programme
resources.summary: Chips brush and branches you have already cut and stacked at the roadside, at no cost to the homeowner.

resources.name: Defensible space cost-share
resources.summary: Shares the cost of larger defensible-space work. Amounts and eligibility vary by year and by funding round — check the current round before planning around it.

resources.name: Chipping and vent mesh
resources.summary: District chipping days, and ember-resistant vent mesh for residents.

resources.name: Ember-resistant vent mesh
resources.summary: Mesh for retrofitting attic and crawlspace vents, for district residents.

resources.agency: San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District
resources.name: Defensible space inspection
resources.summary: The district's own exterior hazard inspection. An official inspection, unlike this app — if you want a determination rather than guidance, this is where to get one.
applies_to_districts: San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District

resources.agency: Contra Costa County Fire Protection District
resources.name: Weed abatement programme
resources.summary: Annual exterior hazard notices and abatement deadlines. Deadlines move each year — check the current one rather than assuming last year's date.
applies_to_districts: Contra Costa County Fire Protection District

resources.name: Look up your evacuation zone
resources.summary: Your official evacuation zone and its current status, from the agencies that issue evacuation orders.
resources.disclaimer: Groundwork provides no evacuation guidance of any kind. This is a link to the official source; follow your fire agency and local law enforcement during an incident.
